name: Network Technology
summary: Gippsland regional ISP (Network Technology Pty Ltd, Morwell VIC), MD Phillip Britt (Aug 1996 - Jun 2000). Built a regional ISP focused in Gippsland providing dial-up services to over 10,000 customers (LinkedIn). Ten 1997 IP-index allocations (NETWORKTECHNOLO-AU x8 + NETCONNECT-NETTECH). Sold to Datafast Telecommunications (later EFTel) in June 2000.

events.details: Managed by Phillip Britt from Aug 1996; built a Gippsland-focused regional ISP providing dial-up to over 10,000 customers (LinkedIn). Ten 1997 IP-index allocations (NETWORKTECHNOLO-AU .. NETWORKTECHNOLO8-AU, NETCONNECT-NETTECH; Morwell/Gippsland VIC, incl. 203.87.28.0/22).
Sold to Datafast Telecommunications Ltd (later EFTel) in June 2000.
